subject: Velox onboarding: SLA & loadproof collaboration plan
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@velox.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@velox.ai; procure@velox.ai
Date: Tue, 03 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Velox onboarding - load/latency targets and artifacts request

Jordan —

Thanks for supporting Velox's onboarding. We want to lock down the acceptance targets and the test artifacts for the initial loadproof run. High level asks from our side: 
- Target SLA: p50 <= 40ms, p95 <= 120ms, p99 <= 180ms for inference requests at baseline traffic.
- Baseline throughput: sustain 200 requests/sec (RPS) with <1% error rate.
- Tail/peak test: brief bursts to 600 RPS to validate graceful degradation and fallback.

Can you share the run plan you intend to execute, what telemetry/logs you'll provide, and a proposed 2-hour window for the run? We also need to understand whether Redwood will run with prefix/KV caching enabled (we expect caching to be allowed) and the model variant you'll exercise.

Attachments: I attached Velox's initial traffic profile (velox-loadplan-v1.xlsx).

Respectfully,
Maria Lopez
VP Engineering, Velox
maria.lopez@velox.ai
+1 (415) 555-2194

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@velox.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Jul 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Velox onboarding - load/latency targets and artifacts request

Maria —

Thanks for the traffic profile and clear targets. We're aligned on scope and can run a validated loadproof that will produce the telemetry artifacts you requested. Quick notes / asks: 
- Proposed model variant: rw-instruct-v2-4B (8-bit quantized). If you require an FP16 run we can schedule that as a follow-up.
- Caching: we'll enable prefix/KV caching by default; we will note cache hit/miss rates in the artifacts. If you want a cache-disabled baseline, say so and we'll include it as an extra stage.
- Telemetry we'll provide: per-request latency histogram (p50/p95/p99), QPS trace, error breakdown by HTTP code and model-side errors, and step-level logs for failed requests. We'll also share the aggregation script we use for SLA metrics.

I've attached our run template so you can see the stages and expected CSVs (redwood-load-run-template.xlsx). Proposed schedule: Wed, 08 Jul 2028 10:00–12:00 PT. Does that work?

Next steps for us if Wed is good: Ben will author the test vectors and run steps, Monica will coordinate access and SOW/Procurement, and I'll own the run and artifact delivery.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Customer Onboarding Lead, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@velox.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Jul 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Velox onboarding - load/latency targets and artifacts request

Hi team —

Adding the test-steps and perf parameters we'll use (summary below). Full config and run commands will be uploaded to the shared folder prior to the run.

Planned load stages (steady state):
- Warmup: 15m at 25% baseline (50 RPS)
- Stage A: 30m at 100 RPS (50% baseline)
- Stage B: 30m at 200 RPS (100% baseline)
- Burst window: 5m spikes to 600 RPS (15s spike cadence)
- Cool-down: 10m at 25%

Other details:
- Prompt length distribution: median ~128 tokens (we'll attach a sampled synthetic dataset to mirror your profile).
- Concurrency: simultaneous 60 connections, token-based rate limiting enforced on the client side.
- Caching: prefix caching enabled, KV cache behavior will be recorded; we will run an optional cache-disabled pass if you request it.
- Collection: per-request trace, model internal timings (where available), system GPU metrics (utilization, memory, temperature), and server-side logs.
- Acceptance criteria script: pass if p99 <= 180ms and error rate < 1% during the 30m Stage B.

Attachments: perf-parameters-0706.txt (config_snippet), and I'll seed the run-logs-0708.zip with the first-run artifacts after the test.

If you have a specific SLA table format, send it over; otherwise we'll use our standard CSV layout.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Performance Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@velox.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Suman Patel <ops@velox.ai>, procure@velox.ai
Date: Tue, 07 Jul 2028 14:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Velox onboarding - load/latency targets and artifacts request

Jordan / Ben —

Wed 08 Jul 10–12 PT works for our infra team. A couple of compliance/security asks before we run: 
- Test data: we'll only allow synthetic or anonymized traffic — no production PII. We'll provide a small synthetic corpus that matches token lengths.
- Evidence: Velox will need the aggregated CSVs and the raw per-request logs (redacted) for audit. Please confirm you can provide redacted traces and a statement of retention (how long Red wood will keep the artifacts).
- Procurement: Procurement needs a simple SOW addendum confirming dates, deliverables, and ownership of logs. Can you route a DocuSign SoW to procure@velox.ai?

I'll also invite our Platform lead (Suman) to the run window.

Thanks — Maria

Maria / team —

Confirming the run tomorrow (Fri 08 Jul was a mis-communication — we were able to shift the prep; actual run scheduled for Mon 11 Jul 09:30–11:30 PT). Apologies for the shift — Ben and I needed to finish the synthetic dataset and a cache-disabled pass.

Quick checklist for the run and artifact handback:
- Synthetic dataset: accepted (Velox provided), we'll only use that.
- Artifacts we'll deliver within 24 hours: aggregated SLA CSV, per-request redacted logs, GPU/system metrics, and the pass/fail report generated by our acceptance script.
- Retention: Redwood will retain raw per-request logs for 90 days (redacted copy shared with Velox); aggregated artifacts and final pass/fail report will be stored with Velox's HubSpot deal record indefinitely unless you request deletion.
- DocuSign SOW: sending now to procure@velox.ai with the dates and deliverables.

Links / deliverables: 
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4521
- DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABCDE-VELOX-SOW

Ben will kick off tomorrow at 09:30 PT and post the run-logs-0711.zip to the shared folder after validation. Monica will coordinate the post-mortem and any follow-up tuning.

Thanks — looking forward to a clean run.

Jordan Blake
